name: qlrisk_saccr
title: SA-CCR exposure at default
description: Basel SA-CCR (CRE52) exposure at default. mode='netting_sets' (default) nets the book per netting set with hedging-set aggregation (IR by currency and maturity bucket, FX by pair, credit / equity by entity, commodity by type), replacement cost, PFE multiplier and alpha 1.4; csa gives each set's margining and collateral. mode='trades' gives each trade's stand-alone RC, add-on and EAD. mode='calculator' runs qlrisk's SA-CCR calculator on trade summaries (netting_set_id (string, default ); trades (array); collateral (number, default 0.0); variation_margin (number, default 0.0); threshold (number, default 0.0); minimum_transfer_amount (number, default 0.0); margin_period_of_risk (number, default 10.0); is_margined (boolean, default False)). Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "notional": 10000000, "tenor_years": 5, "fixed_rate": 0.044, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "csa": {"BANK-A": {"margined": true, "threshold": 0}}}.
